search.website_text:
Removes quest icons above npcs in FFXIV # No Quest Icons

![Plugin Icon](images/icon.png)

**No Quest Icons** is a [Dalamud](https://github.com/goatcorp/Dalamud) plugin for *Final Fantasy XIV* that completely removes the quest icons (diamonds, exclamation/question marks) above NPC nameplates.

## ✨ Features
- Hides quest icons from all NPC nameplates.
- Works 100% client-side — no game files are modified.
- Zero flickering.
- Simple configuration via a tabbed settings window.

## 📦 Installation
1. Add this repository to your **Dalamud Custom Plugin Repositories**.
   - Open Dalamud Settings → Experimental tab → Custom Plugin Repositories.
   - Add:
     ```
     https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GrimmortalDread/NoQuestIcons/main/pluginmaster.json
     ```
2. Search for **No Quest Icons** in the Plugin Installer and install it.

## ⚙️ Usage
- Open the plugin settings from the Dalamud plugin menu.
- Use the **General** tab to toggle quest icon visibility.
- Advanced and About tabs provide extra options and info.

## 📚 Development

This plugin is built against **Dalamud API 15** (.NET 10).
Clone the repo and build with Visual Studio 2026 or Rider.

## 📝 License
This project is licensed under the [MIT License](LICENSE).

## 🙌 Credits
- Plugin author: Grimmortal Dread
- Built with Dalamud API

variant.changelog:
# Version 1.5.0

Roll timers, passes and a way to report problems.

- New: every item in the roll window shows how long is left to roll on it, with a bar that turns amber and then red.
- New: passes now appear in the results, along with items you aren't allowed to roll on and party members who never chose.
- New: while an item is open, the roll window lists who in your party still has to decide.
- New: when an item is awarded, its card plays a short light sweep and spark burst. Follows your particle effect settings.
- Every loot session now reaches an end: items everyone passed on, items that timed out and rolls you left the duty on all close properly.
- Each resolved item leaves the roll window on its own after 20 seconds, with a countdown on the card. Adjustable in Settings - Tracking.
- New: Settings - Diagnostics shows LootView's live log, filterable by level and text, and copies a ready-to-paste report.
- New: Report a bug and Suggest a feature buttons open a pre-filled GitHub issue.
variant.description: Hides every quest icon above NPC nameplates. Icons are sortable and hideable by quest type (Main Scenario, Side Quest, Guildleve, Class/Job Quest, and more), with common types pre-categorized. Includes a peek key to reveal hidden icons on demand and a separate toggle key to switch the whole plugin on/off.
